description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint in ASP.NET Core for listing catalog types in an e-commerce application. It uses dependency injection, AutoMapper for mapping entities to DTOs, and implements the IEndpoint interface to register the route and handle requests.

classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for listing catalog types in the catalog service.
